content.user_title: Plan Chrome Screenshot Mockups with Canvas
content.value_statement: Planning a screenshot mockup extension requires clear capture boundaries and a framing approach. This public guide outlines a no-build Manifest V3 concept using Canvas.
actual_capabilities: Outlines a Manifest V3 extension concept for visible-tab screenshot mockups.
Describes drawing device frames with Canvas instead of external raster assets.
Lists toolbar clicks, context menus, and a keyboard shortcut as intended capture entry points.
Explains a no-build development approach using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Documents visible-area capture and programmatic-frame limitations.
limitations: The package contains only SKILL.md, without extension source, scripts, or templates.
The described extension captures only the visible tab area, not a full scrolling page.
The guide describes programmatic frames only and excludes custom image frames and build-tool workflows.
Runtime behavior, frame availability, performance, and Chrome Web Store compliance cannot be verified from this package.

best_practices: Check available files before requesting implementation changes or claiming that an extension is deployed.
Require explicit user capture actions and use non-sensitive pages when testing a future implementation.

anti_patterns: Treating the documentation-only package as a complete, loadable Chrome extension.
Assuming production-readiness or store approval based solely on marketing claims.
Capturing sensitive pages or sharing screenshots without reviewing their contents and destination.

faq.question: Does this package include the Chrome extension?
faq.answer: No. The supplied package contains only SKILL.md and explicitly excludes extension source, scripts, and templates.

faq.question: What does the guide describe?
faq.answer: It describes a Manifest V3 extension that captures the visible tab area and wraps screenshots in Canvas-drawn device frames.

faq.question: Are build tools required?
faq.answer: The described approach uses JavaScript, HTML, and CSS without NPM or Webpack. No implementation is included to load or test.

faq.question: Does it support full-page captures and custom image frames?
faq.answer: The guide limits capture to the visible tab area and describes programmatic frames rather than custom image frames.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use this guide?
faq.answer: These assistants can use the text for discussion and planning. Actual extension implementation requires additional source code or newly written code.

faq.question: Has screenshot privacy or store compliance been verified?
faq.answer: No. The guide contains no evidence of uploads, but runtime privacy and Chrome Web Store compliance require reviewing the missing extension source.
